item.title: Villa Coco
item.description: ✈ Sangre de Cristo, NM · 34,000 ft I read Ben Lerner’s Transcription mid-flight, mid-June, high above the American Southwest. In the book, the main protagonist drops his phone into the sink. The broken device leaves him with an unexpected serenity, a sense of calmness which is lost when you’re constantly looking at a phone. It was nice looking out the window and noticing the boundless blue sky, and experiencing that same stillness myself in the plane.
